svg.title: One Claude Code session coordinates two others through buddy: it is registered at SessionStart, loads the skill, opens two lanes with the harness, reads the roster and the claims while they work, waits for their DONE, and closes their panes
svg.desc: Every output line is taken from the coordinator session's own transcript (the SessionStart hook's output, each tool call's result, and the session's own words), captured 2026-10-26 in a scratch clone with its own ledger; the typed prompt, the ⏺ Tool(…) call lines and the lines starting with # are typeset. The clone's temporary directory is written … and long lines are soft-wrapped at 112 columns or trimmed with an ellipsis; a # … row marks lines cut from a result; the fast-forward line names how long the picture skips while the lanes worked. Loops every 45 s; under prefers-reduced-motion the final frame is shown still.
svg.text: coordinator — a Claude Code session in the shared checkout

g.text: # SessionStart → buddy hello: the digest every session gets, as its context receives it
BUDDY: you are session coordinator (0cee4f67-3ef5-47a9-935d-3be1328e829f). Claim before taking a bundle: buddy
BUDDY: `buddy --help` lists every verb. Easy to miss: `buddy claim <slug> --dry-run` (forecast a refusal)
`--shared` (lanes co-hold a file); `buddy wait --on <slug>` (declare a wait on a peer) or `--until 2h` alone …
BUDDY: chat tools (chat_read, chat_send) live on the buddylist MCP server, if it is in your tool list; your
